references.text: This is the original instruction that God gave to Moses to make four pillars of acacia wood overlaid with gold, with gold hooks and four silver bases for the curtain in the tabernacle.
Describes similar pillars of acacia wood overlaid with gold for the entrance to the tabernacle, with five pillars and bronze bases.
Acacia wood (שִׁטִּים) is also used to build the ark of the covenant, showing that this was the preferred material for holy objects in the tabernacle.
Describes the five pillars at the entrance to the tent, which complete the description of the four pillars for the curtain in verse 36.
Pillars with silver bases are also used in the courtyard around the tabernacle, showing a consistent pattern in the construction.
The contrast between the entrance pillars (bronze base) and the sanctuary pillars (silver base) emphasizes the degrees of holiness.
